stash of hashish hidden in a sophisticated false bottom. Officers
intercepted the truck on the port road at the Muelle de Poniente and searched it

the hashish and detained the driver, showing him the drugs found in the vehicle
he was driving.

The truck appeared empty and was heading toward boarding for Spain when a
specialist drugs dog alerted, prompting an exhaustive hours-long search inside
and outside the vehicle. After the hours-long detailed inspection, officers
found a large number of bags full of hashish inside the truck's structure.

with first estimates putting the haul above 300 kilograms although police gave
no official weight. The submitted account describes the seizure as about
300 kilograms of hashish arriving from Morocco.

The handcuffed driver was taken to police headquarters and placed under
investigation for an offence against public health. On Sunday, the driver was brought before a judge, who ordered him held in pre-trial detention. Police link the
operation to open UDYCO investigations into groups moving hashish from Ceuta to
mainland Spain in heavy vehicles with hidden compartments.

Police arrested two women at Kattiyavayal, Pudukkottai, on Thursday night while
they were carrying cannabis from Andhra Pradesh by car. Officers seized 26
kilograms of cannabis from them.

Dinamani said the women were handed to the Pudukkottai prohibition enforcement
police, who arrested and jailed them after registering a case. Daily
Thanthi valued the 26 kilograms at about ₹1.3 million and said police seized the
car used for smuggling. Police said preliminary questioning indicated that
the women planned to supply the cannabis to local agents in Pudukkottai and
nearby areas.

report.body:
Kern County sheriff’s deputies arrested Rogelio Lorenzo Francisca, 32, during a
cannabis grow-site investigation in Taft, California. On October 8, 2026,
sheriff’s deputies assigned to the Taft substation, assisted by the Kern County
Sheriff’s Office High Intensity Drug Trafficking Areas Task Force and Taft
Police Department, executed a search warrant in the 27000 block of Highway 119.

Authorities eradicated 660 marijuana plants at the grow site. Pesticides
described as dangerous were also found there.

Francisca was arrested for cultivation and sales of marijuana, conspiracy, and
delaying, resisting or obstructing an arrest. The investigation was
described as active and ongoing.
